Issue Title: [BUG] Mem0 Storage metadata limit breach Description: ### Description When trying to user External Memory with Mem0. The save request can get failed if metadata length is more than 2000 characters. This is because we are sending assistant message, user message and system prompt in the metadata. ### Steps to Reproduce Use external memory, and ask to generate a response more than 2000 characters. ### Expected behavior Should work without an issue. ### Screenshots/Code snippets ### Operating System macOS Sonoma ### Python Version 3.11 ### crewAI Version Latest ### crewAI Tools Version Latest ### Virtual Environment Venv ### Evidence - ### Possible Solution #3390 ### Additional context -
